observations: Front item shows a lens barrel engraved "AF-S NIKKOR" and "50mm 1.8G" with "Nikon" branding, visible in photos 0, 1, and 2.
A second, similar black lens with a Nikon logo and distance scale sits behind the front lens in all three photos.
A lens hood (black, flared) is visible to the right rear in photos 0 and 2.
Front glass element appears clear and unscratched in the close-up shots, no visible fungus or haze in the photographed angle.
No rear mount, serial number plate, or box/accessories (caps, pouch) are shown in any photo.
Item is laid on bubble wrap and a plastic sheet, suggesting a packing/shipping setup rather than a studio test shot.
A watermark 'Olajide Amos Bishop' overlays all images.

claims.evidence: No import sticker, US-market box, or receipt shown in any photo; origin cannot be confirmed from images.

Front element looks clear in photos 0-2, but no shot of lens against bright light to check for internal haze/fungus, no rear element shot, and no functional test (autofocus, aperture blades) is shown.

risks.risk: Internal optical defects (fungus, haze, dust, scratches) not visible under normal lighting
risks.proof: A video or photo of the lens held up to bright light/sun from both front and rear, showing all internal elements.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having unverified optical condition, i.e. at the lower end as if minor haze/fungus present

risks.risk: Autofocus motor and aperture blade functionality unknown
risks.proof: A short video showing the lens mounted on a camera, autofocus cycling, and aperture blades stopping down when the camera trips the lever.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working (AF/aperture fault assumed) until shown

risks.proof: Close-up of the rear mount showing Nikon CPU contacts and the engraved serial number, cross-checked against Nikon's serial format.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified authenticity, discounted versus a confirmed-genuine unit

risks.risk: Ambiguous listing: a second lens is visible behind the main one in every photo, unclear if it is included or just a prop
risks.proof: A seller photo or statement isolating exactly what is included in the sale (one lens vs. two, plus hood/caps).
risks.if_unproven: priced for only the single 50mm 1.8G lens shown in focus, hood and second lens excluded

risks.risk: Mount and electronic contact wear not shown
risks.proof: A clear photo of the rear bayonet mount and CPU contact strip.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having unverified mount condition, treated as average wear

proof_requests: Video of lens mounted on a Nikon body showing autofocus and aperture blade operation
Photo of lens held against bright light showing front and rear elements for haze/fungus/scratches
Close-up of rear mount and serial number plate
Clarification on what exactly is included in the sale (single lens, hood, caps, second lens?)
response.reason: The lens is clearly identifiable as a Nikon AF-S NIKKOR 50mm f/1.8G from the engraved text in all three photos, and cosmetic condition can be judged, but functional and optical claims ('like new') are unverified so it must be priced at worst case pending proof.
